D11.name: 黄鳝
D11.form: an elongated cylindrical eel-like body, a short stout head, small eyes, a relatively large mouth, smooth scaleless skin, the left and right gill openings merged into a single V-shaped opening on the underside of the head
D11.fins: no pectoral or pelvic fins in adults, the dorsal and anal fins reduced to low skin folds
D11.markings: irregular markings on the underside, small spots on the body
D11.colour: 体背灰黑色，腹部灰白色，有黑色点斑

D12.name: 青虾虎
D12.markings: a prominent spot on the tail fin
D12.colour: 体色淡蓝色或绿色，尾巴上带有很明显的黑斑

D13.name: 金鲫
D13.form: a spindle-shaped body, a deep laterally compressed body, medium-sized scales, cycloid scales except on the head, a complete straight lateral line
D13.fins: pelvic fins set slightly ahead of the dorsal fin origin, pelvic fins similar in shape to the pectoral fins, a deeply forked tail fin with rounded lobe tips
D13.colour: 体背部灰黑色、微绿，体侧银灰色或带黄绿色，腹部白色，背鳍和尾鳍与背部同色，胸、腹和臀鳍灰色

D14.name: 老塘草鱼
D14.form: an elongated body, an almost cylindrical anterior part, a laterally compressed tail region, a rounded belly, no ventral keel, a broad medium-sized head, a slightly flattened anterior head, a short blunt snout, medium-sized cycloid scales, a lateral line curved anteriorly and straight posteriorly

D15.name: 圆尾斗鱼
D15.form: a body covered with scales, cycloid scales on the head, ctenoid scales on the flanks
D15.fins: long large dorsal and anal fins, pelvic fins set below the pectoral region, a rounded tail fin; in mature males the posterior rays of the dorsal and anal fins are longer
D15.colour: 身体呈黑褐色，腹鳍呈灰褐色，胸鳍为淡黄色，奇鳍为微红色

D16.name: 塘主的大青鱼
D16.form: an elongated body, a slightly compressed body, a rounded belly, no ventral keel, a broad blunt head, a terminal mouth, no barbels, large cycloid scales, a complete lateral line
D16.fins: a long dorsal fin with no spines, a forked tail fin
D16.colour: 体背青黑色，体侧青灰色，腹部灰白色

C02.name: 马口鱼
C02.form: an elongated slightly compressed body, a hump behind the head, a narrow caudal peduncle, a rounded belly, a large rounded head, a short broad snout with a pointed tip, a large wide terminal mouth sloping downward, a pair of short barbels at the corners of the mouth, fine small scales
C02.fins: the first to fourth branched anal fin rays elongated in males, nuptial tubercles on the head, pectoral and anal fins in the breeding season
C02.markings: over ten bands crossing the flanks
C02.colour: 雄性体背部灰黑色，腹部银白色，胸鳍橙黄色；雌性身体无蓝色条纹

C03.name: 宽鳍鱲
C03.form: an elongated laterally compressed body, a pointed head, a terminal mouth, no barbels, medium-sized scales, a complete lateral line
C03.colour: 体侧具垂直条纹，繁殖期雄鱼体色鲜艳，颊部及体侧有粉红及蓝色条纹

C04.name: 拉氏鱥
C04.form: a subterminal mouth, medium-sized eyes, very small scales, a complete lateral line
C04.fins: a short small dorsal fin, oval pectoral fins, a slightly concave tail fin
C04.markings: irregular small spots scattered on the flanks, a spot at the base of the tail
C04.colour: 体背部呈灰黄色，腹部呈白色
